card.name: Heart rhythm warnings: linking words
card.fires_on: Partway through or right after cardiac rhythm terms (symptomatic, syncope, bradycardia, Brugada, QT, torsade), on the word or punctuation that links to the next heart-related term.

modes.label: Inside 'symptomatic'
modes.description: Middle of 'symptomatic' before heart failure or bradycardia.
modes.example: MULTAQ is contraindicated in patients with sympt<<omatic>> heart failure with recent decompensation requiring

modes.label: Linking words in rhythm lists
modes.description: Small words or punctuation such as 'as', 'with', 'e.g.,' or 'or' introducing arrhythmia conditions.
modes.example: Sinus node disease, such<< as>> sick sinus syndrome or symptomatic brad

modes.label: Parenthesis after slow heart rate
modes.description: An opening bracket listing symptoms of rhythm problems.
modes.example: Monitor for signs and symptoms suggestive of slow heart rate<< (>>fainting, dizziness) or rapid

card.plain: It fires on connecting words in warnings about slow or abnormal heart rhythms, just before the specific condition is named.
